newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares plunge on U.S. developments.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares plunge on U.S. developments.

text.p: Norwegian shares fell sharply on Tuesday after overnight losses on Wall Street and stronger than expected U.S. housing starts data.
The Oslo Total index closed 1.41 percent lower at 920.03 points in trade worth a moderate 763 million crowns.
"First Wall Street burdened the index and then came the housing stocks which were higher than expected, sending bond yields higher and knocking down stocks further," one broker said.
"We expect some volatility and specticism as we head for Christmas," he said. "But there is a lot of AMS tax money that is going to enter the market in the next few weeks."
The AMS regulations give people tax breaks if they invest money in the stock market around New Years.

Industrial giant Norsk Hydro fell 1.5 percent to 323.50 crowns, Norske Skogindustrier forestry group A shares dropped 2.9 percent to 200 crowns flat and food-based conglomerate Orkla A shares were down 1.4 percent at 427 crowns.
